integrity: All numerical assertions follow from exhaustive face enumeration, an explicit acyclic face matching, certified elementary collapses and an exact nonzero integral top-cycle witness, all reproducible using the included standard-library program.
scientific_limitations: This proves the exact homotopy type only for the four-by-four Cartesian square grid; it does not settle the wedge-of-spheres conjecture for arbitrary rectangular grids. Independent mathematical audit is not performed.
title: The four-by-four grid perfect-matching complex is a mixed-dimensional sphere wedge
